verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss is a hosted real-estate CRM. Open-source CRMs exist, so asking whether its source is under an open license is a fair question. The evidence shows no open-licensed product source: the only GitHub link is a repository of Bash and PHP API examples, which is adjacent developer material rather than the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
